# Texas United Patriots

> Texas United Patriots (texasunitedpatriots.org) is a grassroots conservative movement of more than 50,000 Texans in all 254 counties. It raises money for Texans, for veterans and for the conservative movement, never for candidates or politicians. Faith. Family. Freedom.

## Join and support

- Join the movement: https://texasunitedpatriots.org/members.html
- Claim a free 2026 member card: https://texasunitedpatriots.org/member-card.html
- About the movement: https://texasunitedpatriots.org/about.html
- Issues: https://texasunitedpatriots.org/issues.html
